name: Catalogue hero card (copy | media)
purpose: Open a content-catalogue page with an eyebrow, H1, short pitch and tour CTA beside a large image or video.
description: Legacy content ('yellow') theme, two hairline-framed grid cells (one column <=767): left card with a dark eyebrow pill, serif 3rem/1.1 H1 (2rem <=479), grey paragraph and a yellow pill button; right cell is media. One component with `variant`: 'topics' (/content/topics) shows a 923:600 header image (3:2 <=991); 'suites' (/content/sector-suites) shows a 500px background-video slot. Content shape is identical.

variant.note: topics = image media, suites = background-video media.
